topics.label: Introduction to cancer therapy
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the lecture's structure and learning objectives regarding cancer treatment approaches.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and cytotoxic chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms, toxicities, and drug resistance associated with conventional cancer treatments.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic cancer cell vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that exploit specific biological defects in cancer cells, including checkpoint and DNA repair deficiencies.

topics.label: Oncogene targeting and kinase inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on small molecule inhibition of oncogenic kinase signaling and the molecular mechanisms of acquired drug resistance.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibody and antibody-drug conjugate therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover therapeutic approaches utilizing targeted antibodies to directly eliminate tumor cells or deliver cytotoxic payloads.

topics.label: Cancer immunotherapy and T-cell redirection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the relationship between the immune system and cancer along with strategies to harness and engineer T cells against tumors.

topics.label: Therapeutic challenges, progress, and future directions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review clinical hurdles, historical treatment achievements, and emerging considerations for future cancer management.
